systems.country_label: Electronic phytosanitary certification system, Plant and Animal Quarantine Services, Ministry of Agriculture

note: Launch of an IPPC/FAO ePhyto certificate system said to align with international standards; names no standards body membership, no adopted IT standard and no requirement or committee.
Telecom numbering plan defines numbers by ITU-T E.164 and E.212; no standards-body membership, national adoption of an IT standard, requirement on government systems or committee seat is stated.

facts.fact: The Liberia Standards Authority gained Correspondent Membership of ISO, per its statement of 7 October 2025.

note: The document states nothing this study asks for this country.
Budapest and Malabo alignment is not an ISO or IEC standard.
Document states nothing on standards bodies; FATF standards are not ISO or IEC.
Only alignment with open contracting standards in general terms.
ISO/IEC 27001 is named only in a proposed Act's standards clause; no membership, adoption or binding requirement is stated.

facts.fact: Liberian Observer reports Liberia Standards Authority Director General Stephen Y. Mambu announced that Liberia is now a full member of ISO.
ISO's member page lists the Liberia Standards Authority (LiSA) as a Correspondent member of ISO.
